test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A invested an amount of Rs. 12,000 in a fixed deposit scheme for 2 years at an interest rate of 5% per annum, compounded annually. How much amount will A get on maturity of the fixed deposit?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 12000

Time period = 2 years

Rate = 5 %

**Formula used:**

Amount = Principal (1 + Rate/100)<span style=" line-height: 0; position:
